content:
anika: heads-up — after calico 3.28 rollout to west2-gpu we're seeing 15–20% pod-to-pod packet loss and a big jump in p99 token latency (+~120ms). affected nodepool: gpu-X.

sam: yep, load tests hit a lot more retransmits. looks correlated with GSO/GRO counters spiking on RDMA-enabled nodes. attaching short tcpdump sample.

leo: can you paste `ip link show` and `sysctl -a | grep net.core` from one of the affected hosts? want to check MTU and rmem/wmem.

marta: ethtool counters from node gpu-X-02: `ethtool -S eth0 | grep -E \"gso|gro|tso\"` ->
```
gso_packets: 18432
gro_flows: 0
tso_packets: 0
```
weird that gro_flows is zero.

infra-bot: deploybot: calico/3.28 rolled to cluster west2-gpu at 2024-11-07T14:02:12Z by @deploy-engineering :gear:

anika: tcpdump snippet from pod A -> pod B (short):
```
12:32:11.123456 IP podA > podB: Flags [P.], seq 1:1451, ack 1, win 65535, length 1450
12:32:11.123467 IP podA > podB: Flags [.], seq 1451:2901, ack 1, win 65535, length 1450
12:32:11.124000 IP podB > podA: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
```
we see multiple segments and some resets.

ryan: quick mitigation option: disable GSO/GRO on iface: `ethtool -K eth0 gso off gro off tso off`. can try on one host.

sam: tried GRO off on gpu-X-02 — p50 latency improved but p99 still elevated. noticed that the tunnel MTU for geneve was clamped from 1450 -> 1426 after the calico config change (encap MTU calc changed). fragmentation appears to be happening mid-path.

leo: can you dump the CNI config for the node? e.g. `/etc/cni/net.d/10-calico.conflist` — curious about `encapsulation` and `mtu` settings.

marta: posted snippet to ticket CNICORE-1123 with Calico support. they asked for `dmesg` and BPF map show: `bpftool map show` output attached.

anika: rolling back calico 3.28 to 3.27 in a canary AZ now to validate rollback. will watch metrics for next 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: automation: rollback job started for west2-gpu-canary at 14:45 UTC by @anika (job id: rb-3371).

sam: rollback completed on canary AZ — p99 returned to baseline within ~90s. leaving rollbacks paused and alerting until root cause confirmed.

leo: next steps: 1) reproduce with MTU/geneve encap matrix locally, 2) run kernel GSO/GRO regression tests on RDMA-enabled kernels, 3) coordinate with Calico on BPF code paths that clamp mtu/encap.

marta: added notes to incident tracker and slack thread: will attach full logs and calico config diffs.

anika: thanks all — folks on-call, keep an eye on west2-gpu for the next 2 hours, I'll update CNICORE ticket with logs. :thumbsup:
